to.description: Recipient: a template resolving to a person reference, or an email literal.

link.description: 'auto' to deep-link the record, or a URL.

when.description: A condition on THIS effect, checked after the workflow's own and against the record as it stands when this effect is reached — so it sees what an earlier effect in the same list just wrote. Without it, everything a workflow does is governed by one rule, and the only way to make two of its effects answer to different rules is to split it into two workflows with near-identical triggers.
